title: Introduction to Education Profession for ESL Students

program.section_heading: Introduction to Education Profession for ESL Students - Certificate of Competency - MCC8007
outcomes: Produce well-organized and well-developed descriptive and expository paragraphs about the Amer i can Public Education system (K-12).
Explain the fundamental concepts (e.g. IEP , LRE , FAPE, and Special Education Categories) that shape educational services.
Develop and compose short (400-700 word) essays using APA or MLA format on Education issues regarding federal legislation, state mandates, or educational practices.
Analyze the readings as it pertains to the multicultural perspectives of education professionals, includ ing teachers an d teacher assistants.

notes: The award is a noncredit Certificate of Competency counted in hours. Course and total values are hours: 24 + 24, with a printed total of 48.00 hours.
The catalog prints the codes with a hyphen (ESL-804, ESL-805). They match closed-list ESL 804 and ESL 805, so they are not marked as catalog additions.

The outcomes are copied as printed and keep apparent text-extraction spacing artifacts: 'Amer i can', 'IEP , LRE ,', 'includ ing teachers an d'. A reviewer may want to check these against the source page.
